text:
aj: kicked off kernel livepatch to canary pool (nodepool-gpu-canary-3) at 08:10 UTC. saw alerts from one node about MIG device misassignments.
maria: can you paste the node + raw output?
aj: first seen on gpu-canary-07 at 08:12 UTC. deploy-bot: started canary 08:10 UTC.
lee: nvidia-smi dump from gpu-canary-07:
lee: ```
$ nvidia-smi -L
GPU 0: A100-SXM4-80GB (UUID: GPU-11A)
  MIG 0g.1gb Device 0: (UUID: MIG-QQQ1)
  MIG 1g.5gb Device 1: (UUID: MIG-QQQ1)
GPU 1: A100-SXM4-80GB (UUID: GPU-22B)
  MIG 0g.1gb Device 0: (UUID: MIG-RRR2)
```
lee: note the same MIG UUID repeated for two profiles on GPU 0.
nisha: that looks like the mig-manager didn't re-sync cleanly after module reload; could be hostengine state duplication.
aj: pods with GPU request '1g.5gb' can't map, init logs: `NCCL WARN  net : All devices failed` / `No device matches requested UUID: MIG-QQQ1`.
lee: `nvidia-smi mig -gci` fails with `Failed to query MIG device info: driver api mismatch`.
maria: stack on node? pls include driver/kernel/cuda/nccl
lee: kernel=6.1.24-livepatch, nvidia-driver=535.104, cuda=12.2, nccl=2.17.6.
sre-charlie: auto-pause signal to infra: pause the livepatch rollout to stop blasted churn :warning:
infra-bot: automation paused livepatch rollout due to MIG mapping errors >3% in canary at 08:25 UTC.
nisha: immediate mitigation: cordon/drain and restart mig service then force a rescan:

nisha: ```sh
kubectl cordon gpu-canary-07
systemctl restart nvidia-mig-manager
nvidia-smi mig -r
``` 
lee: after restart the `nvidia-smi -L` output normalized but device indices changed; a handful of small-memory replicas OOMed during reschedule.
aj: propose adding a pre-deploy validator: run `nvidia-smi -L` and check for duplicate MIG UUIDs per GPU and ensure `nvidia-smi mig -gci` returns healthy. Fail rollout on detection.
maria: also add a log pattern alert for `driver api mismatch` and surface a `mig_uuid_conflict` metric from node-exporter parsing.
sre-charlie: note costs: churn + autoscaler oscillation in the canary pool estimated extra ~$1.9k for the week unless we reduce flapping.
lee: filed INC-20240601-017 with dumps, dmesg, kube events. attaching full logs.
infra-bot: incident INC-20240601-017 created by lee at 08:37 UTC. assigned: eng-infra; priority: P2.
maria: next steps: 1) rollback livepatch on canary nodes, 2) perform full mig-manager reset on updated hosts before rejoin, 3) add rollout preflight and run small NCCL connectivity tests post-join, 4) bake the checks into CI.
aj: rolling back and pushing a hotfix to the deployment job now; will share node list and timelines.
lee: updating runbook: block kernel livepatch for GPU nodes until we have gated mig-manager compatibility checks. will expand notes with `dmesg` snippets.
sre-charlie: watching other regions; us-east + eu remain green. escalate to vendor if we see cross-region recurrence.
aj: thanks — will follow up in the incident with postmortem once we stabilize.
